data.narrative:
Notus Autonomous Systems is a Seed-stage company in Defense & Security founded by Emmanuel Margolin and Arhum Jain, having raised $500K to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI at similar or adjacent stages.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression uses the $500K raised as a proxy base value and applies a typical 2.5x multiplier for advancement from Seed to next stage, implying $1.25M. Peer-median analysis examines three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—UFORCE (Seed, $1.0B), Singularity (Series A, $400M), and NODA AI (Series A, $125M)—yielding a median valuation of $400M with a range of $125M to $1.0B.

The triangulated analysis produces a median estimate of $201M, with a low bound of $1M and a high bound of $460M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty: stage-progression suggests early-stage pricing near $1M, while peer-median implies substantial value closer to $400M. This divergence underscores dependence on (1) whether Notus's technology and traction approach peers like UFORCE, (2) market timing and investor appetite in defense tech, and (3) validation of the $500K raise as representative of true implied value at Seed inception.
